description.value: Embarc Ucluelet is a Hilton Grand Vacations timeshare resort situated beside a fishing village on Vancouver Island within the Water's Edge resort complex on Harbour Crescent. The property offers 1- and 2-Bedroom Suites with full kitchens, fireplaces, and private patios or balconies with water views, plus a full-service day spa on site. It sits close to the Wild Pacific Trail, Pacific Rim National Park Reserve, and a range of ocean adventure activities, making it a notable base for those who can secure a booking.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms the OSM address (1971 Harbour Crescent, Ucluelet, BC V0R 3A0) and phone (250-726-2557). The amenities section explicitly lists Laundry and Wi-Fi; in-suite washer/dryer is also confirmed in the suite description. No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, drying area, e-bike charging, or any other cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the page. The property is a Hilton Grand Vacations timeshare membership resort (Embarc/Diamond Resorts brand), which may limit walk-in bookability for touring cyclists.
concerns: Property operates as a Hilton Grand Vacations timeshare membership resort; walk-in or independent bookability for non-members is unclear and may be limited.
OSM lists the brand as Diamond Resorts; the website now operates fully under the Hilton Grand Vacations / Embarc umbrella — the URL still resolves but the brand has changed.
Neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is addressed anywhere on the website.
